notes.title: Skater Cally Release Date Confirmed - September 25th
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33561827/d99e13c04205e3e56a06cc22be64d62102aa7fd6.png

Hey Everyone!
We are so excited to announce the release date has been set for September 25th for Skater Cally.  We've been working really hard through the beta period, and can't wait for everyone to see the final product.  In addition to the main game, the Soundtrack will also be available and you can purchase both as the Skater Cally Deluxe Edition.  You can also check out a  Gameplay trailer here.
